parties.respondent: Maniben Jagmalbhai (Deceased) Through L.R.s and Ors.

summary: Dispute over land (Revenue Survey No. 49, 6 acres 15 gunthas, Mahadeviya village) arising from a 1975 sale deed. Petitioner claimed fraudulent execution of deed for entire property; respondent asserted lawful purchase and possession. Trial court denied cancellation and declaration but granted permanent injunction to respondent for possession of 5 acres 15 gunthas. First Appellate and High Court upheld injunction. Petitioner challenged viability of injunction without title, arguing possession was unlawful post-sale. Issues: limitation, lawful possession, applicability of Specific Relief Act. Supreme Court examined whether possession could be protected independently of title and whether injunction was barred by limitation.
legal_provisions_cited: Section 38 of the Specific Relief Act
Section 41 of the Specific Relief Act
final_judgment: Appeal allowed. Permanent injunction set aside. Petitioner entitled to possession of entire suit property as sale deed was upheld and possession under void title cannot be protected.
